BiblicalUsage: Ornan was the Jebusite whose threshingfloor David bought to build an altar, when the angel stood by it with a drawn sword over Jerusalem. The temple itself was built on that floor, on Mount Moriah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ornan's threshingfloor is the proof that God meets us in the most ordinary places: a farmer's floor became the site of the temple.
